articles.title: EPS-95 higher pension row: Pensioners’ body writes to President Murmu, seeks withdrawal of EPFO's ‘flawed’ circular
articles.summary: The National Confederation of Pensioners Associations (NCPA), representing over a million pensioners from public sector undertakings and provident fund establishments, has formally initiated action by writing regarding their concerns. This development underscores the continuous efforts by pensioner bodies to ensure their welfare and address issues related to provident funds and pensions, highlighting crucial aspects of national social security and public sector accountability.

articles.title: Russia halts strikes on Ukraine’s Kherson as Oleshky ceasefire takes effect
articles.summary: Russia has suspended military strikes in Ukraine's Kherson province, implementing a localized ceasefire. This pause is to facilitate a humanitarian mission, which is notably being led by United States First Lady Melania Trump. The temporary cessation of hostilities aims to ensure the safe passage and delivery of aid, underscoring international efforts to provide assistance amidst the conflict.
